scope: Twelve animation concepts with three independently generated ImageGen key-pose images each, for feedback before production animation.
feedback: Develop, Revise or Skip per idea; notes per idea or pose; export feedback JSON for review.
productionPlan: Select and approve key poses, draw registered separate eye and mouth layers with in-betweens and timing, test loops and transitions plus audible speech synchronization, then enable one family at a time with the existing family retained as fallback.
limitations: These are static key-pose concepts, not complete motion sequences or a complete viseme pack.
Generated texture, palette and registration need normalization when producing final animation assets.
Production motion, landscape registration, transitions and voice synchronization require the next animation pass.
